## Summary

Explain the problem and the solution. Link the related issue.

## Verification

List the commands and in-game checks performed.

## Compatibility impact

Describe effects on existing worlds, Lua programs, public Java APIs, resource IDs and addon mods. Write `None` only
after checking.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated reformatting.
- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass.
- [ ] Visual changes include before-and-after screenshots.
- [ ] Generated resources were regenerated instead of edited independently.
- [ ] Existing SPDX notices were preserved and new files have accurate licensing metadata.
- [ ] Third-party code and assets have documented provenance.
- [ ] Substantial generative-AI assistance is disclosed and the result was manually reviewed.
